description: This Java class 'LocationEditor' extends 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' for serializing and deserializing 'Location' objects in the OpenMRS framework. It provides methods to retrieve Location objects by ID or UUID, facilitating form data handling and object management within the application.

classes.name: LocationEditor
classes.description: A property editor for serializing/deserializing Location objects in OpenMRS, supporting lookup by ID and UUID.

methods.name: LocationEditor
methods.description: Default constructor for the LocationEditor class.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Location object based on its ID.

methods.description: Retrieves a Location object based on its UUID.
